target.description: Independent first-principles review of project-knowledge/control architecture residency, ownership, reuse and instantiation before ChatGPT freezes a topology recommendation.

known_exposures: Claude receives the neutral residency/reuse question and exact pre-candidate repository evidence.
Research 236, Research 237, Checkpoint 567, descendant CURRENT_STATE/KNOWLEDGE_MAP synthesis and future PKIA candidate material are excluded before Message 001.
Earlier Research 177/218 and Research 219-235 are intentionally available because they are pre-candidate evidence needed to understand the current architecture and control-plane growth.
independence.notes: Independence is candidate-blind rather than history-blind. Claude may independently derive any topology, including project-native, external, materialized, hybrid or another design, but is not shown ChatGPT's current topology framing before Message 001.

last_transition.reason: PKIA-E01 reached the point where a candidate-blind second-model review can add epistemic value before ChatGPT freezes a topology recommendation.
